name: Shin
source:
Souichirou and Kyouko's acquaintance. Shin is currently working at the town hall as a postman on Haikyo island. 
He had feelings for [url=/c89754]Atori[/url], however, knowing the circumstance with her lover, he couldn't bring himself to convey it directly. 
Has an obedient personality, which is a hindrance to having things going his own way.
